fusions.name: Bramble Paw
fusions.desc: Swipes a bramble-clawed paw across a cone 2.5 tiles long, dealing 9 damage with a 60% chance to leave each enemy [Bleeding] for 5 seconds. Holds 3 charges; a kill restores one.

fusions.name: Rootbound Hug
fusions.desc: Crushes one enemy for 30 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health. Roots hold it [Pinned] for 3 seconds and it is 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Dormant Season
fusions.desc: Restores 4 health a second to you for 8 seconds. The healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Berry Fat
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 15, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
